title: Huge Market Reaction! Here Is What You Need To Know
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Markets gapped up on reports Trump may ease sanctions if Iran makes nuclear progress; he is skeptical.
10y yield at multi-decade highs; the bond market can't be ignored much longer.
~73% odds of a hike at the next FOMC; PCE and JOLTS this week will shift them.
Russia diesel export ban extension and $9 diesel in California will feed into CPI.

calls.reason: Markets very elevated after a big week; red flags from the bond market; expects pullback risk to outweigh short-term upside.
calls.quote: markets are elevated and likely to to to pull back in the short term

calls.condition: If Nasdaq breaks support, another leg down
calls.reason: Nasdaq down ~1% after an attempted recovery, testing support.
calls.quote: if it does break the support, we have another leg down.

calls.reason: Near all-time highs after a big buyback announcement; not a good deal short term but he stays invested long term.
